projects.description:
ActionModel is developing a community-owned Large Action Model (LAM), an artificial intelligence system designed to perform real-world digital tasks on computers by interacting with graphical user interfaces (GUIs), rather than just generating text like traditional Large Language Models (LLMs). It monitors screen states, decides on actions (such as clicking on coordinates, entering text, or scrolling) using its own action tree built from user input, executes those actions, and loops until the task is complete. This enables offline automation of workflows such as data entry, website navigation, or application operations without the use of APIs.

The project counteracts the centralized development of AI by large tech companies through community contributions: users install a browser extension for passive or active learning and create/sell reusable workflows on a marketplace, where their completion earns creators ongoing rewards.

Actionist's desktop application serves as a tool for user interaction, enabling the creation of specialized AI agents (digital employees with memory, schedules, personalities, and access to tools) that work locally or in the cloud around the clock, with full history tracking for transparency.

$LAM is a proprietary token that enables actions to work, rewards learning and contribution, provides governance, and represents an ownership stake in the AI system.

projects.description:
BULK is a decentralized trading system designed to bridge the speed gap between centralized and decentralized markets. The project architecture includes:

Low-latency order matching and propagation in the 5-20 ms range, with the prospect of evolving to the microsecond level.

Decentralization with no leaders, no single point of failure, leader-block producers and centralized sequencers.

Verifiability and openness, where the state of the system is cryptographically verifiable and the participation of validators is open and enforced by economic steak.

A high-performance orderbook capable of handling workloads well above current onchain systems.

BULK utilizes deterministic FIFO mapping, provides colocation-level speed through a network of validators, supports gasless orders and APIs for integration. There are no bridges or sequencers in the architecture, reducing the risks of centralization and security vulnerabilities. Solana is used to store assets and calculations, and a separate execution layer is optimized for high speed.

projects.description:
Miden is a zero-disclosure (ZK) convolution layer 2 blockchain designed to improve the scalability, privacy and security of the blockchain by moving transaction execution and state management to the client side. This approach allows users to locally generate and validate their own transactions, reducing the need for re-execution on the main chain. By providing client-side validation, Miden aims to ease the computational burden on the network, contributing to more efficient and scalable decentralized applications.

From a privacy perspective, the Miden architecture gives users full control over their data and transaction details through self-managed state management. Security is enhanced by supporting the development of smart contracts in Rust and implementing built-in account abstraction. In addition, a proprietary asset store for user accounts minimizes the attack surface, improving overall system reliability.

The platform provides leverage of up to 10x on these trades, allowing users to take increased positions on forecasts without the leverage limitations or liquidations inherent in the base version.

Calculations are performed using oracles such as Pyth and SEDA to accurately verify and finalize event outcomes. Markets cover categories such as sports (e.g. cricket tournaments), cryptocurrency price trends, memes and entertainment results. Users interact by placing trades with yes/no or binary results and receive winnings once they are resolved.

Technically, it runs on Hyperliquid's HyperCore infrastructure, utilizing HyperEVM to provide smart contract functionality.

projects.description:
Stormrae is an AI-centric platform built on the Solana blockchain. It creates a layer for user participation in AI development. Its main goal is to turn complex AI-related tasks such as model evaluation, testing and adversarial data generation into accessible consumer applications. The platform allows real users to contribute feedback and behavioral data needed to improve AI systems. These contributions are recorded as verifiable artifacts on the blockchain. The project targets both non-technical users who can participate through engaging applications and developers who can create, share and monetize AI models within an open ecosystem.

On the technical side, Stormrae works through a modular participation architecture that connects consumer activity with enterprise AI development processes. The platform tracks user contributions through Shards (Shards - units of participation) and Echoes (activity signals), which form a verifiable contribution history on the Solana blockchain.

projects.description:
t54 Labs is developing a financial infrastructure designed for autonomous AI agents. The project focuses on integrating large language models (LLMs) into the economic environment, giving machines the ability to perform financial transactions autonomously.

Main components:
Protocol Implementation: The project uses the HTTP 402 (Payment Required) status code to create a standardized method for AI-driven payments.

Infrastructure: The platform functions as a payment relay based on the XRP Ledger (XRPL), utilizing XRP and RLUSD assets for settlement.

Risk management: The system includes a real-time risk control module that monitors agent behavior and enforces spending limits.

Interoperability: t54 provides a plug-and-play API that allows developers to empower their agents with payment functions without having to manage separate accounts for each service with which the agent interacts.

Vibe Trading is an open-ended futures trading platform specializing in the placement and trading of low market capitalization tokens, memcoins and utility tokens with free and instant placement. Projects or token holders deposit their own tokens into the vault to provide an open-ended marketplace - with no minimum deposit, no USDC/ETH/SOL pairing, and no placement fees - allowing for instant trading with up to 60x leverage.

Traders can utilize features such as Ape Mode for one-click orders, drag-and-drop elements on the chart, hotkeys, and volume-based rakebacks. Depositors (often project teams) receive the majority of trading commissions in perpetuity due to the volume generated on their deposited perpetual tokens, utilizing idle treasury tokens.
